idea-plugin.name: Ingress-NGINX Retirement Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Names the Gateway API field that replaces each retired ingress-nginx annotation — or tells you there isn't one

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Ingress-NGINX Retirement Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 30 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/ingress-nginx-retirement-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/ingress-nginx-retirement-lint

action.text: Ingress-NGINX Retirement Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Ingress-NGINX Retirement Lint on the file in the editor
